Starlink saves lives

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Elon Musk megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: AmandaLovesElon (@AmandaLovesElon); megjelent: 2026-11-01T13:30:51+00:00; link: https://x.com/AmandaLovesElon/status/2116885685743321273; média: 1 kép]
✨️🚀Starlink saves lives, and this time it was right here in Britain. 🇬🇧✨️🚀

🔥A walker fell into a hornets' nest down a steep bank in Cumbria. The rescuers had no mobile signal, but Starlink got the call through, and the walker is safe.

✝️"My help cometh from the LORD, which made heaven and earth." Psalm 121:2 (KJV)

Thank you @SpaceX @elonmusk 🙏
